name: Galaxy Agrico Exports Limited
summary: Galaxy Agrico Exports Limited, founded in 1992 and based in Rajkot, India, specializes in the production and supply of a broad spectrum of agricultural implements and tools. Their extensive product catalog features items such as hoes, pick mattocks, shovels, spades, garden forks, digging tools, cultivator blades, various metal bars, axes, wood-splitting wedges, hammers, tool handles, and bearing cages.
